page_title: VER 3-2 ROM | Verona v AS Roma 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
90+4' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Angelino (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

90+1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' 3 - 2 Goal - 3:2! Abdou Harroui (Verona) receives a precise pass inside the box from Dailon Rocha Livramento and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
87' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Flavius Daniliuc is replaced by Davide Faraoni (Verona).
87' Suat Serdar comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Silva (Verona).
86' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) sprays a pass out to Lorenzo Pellegrini, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
85' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
84' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

82' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
81' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will come up with.
81' Here comes a substitution. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Kone.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' It must be a yellow card. It is. Manu Kone (AS Roma) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
78' Ondrej Duda (Verona) tries to find Abdou Harroui, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
77' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) replacing Tomas Suslov.
76' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
74' Substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) in, Artem Dovbyk out.
73' Paolo Zanetti is stunned as referee Matteo Marcenaro shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
73' Wonderful movement by AS Roma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
71' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends the corner into the box, but Mile Svilar intercepts it and averts the threat.
71' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Good work from Verona as they win a corner.
70' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Here is a change. Enzo Le Fee is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma).
66' That's the end of the game for Matias Soule, who is replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
66' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski makes his way off the pitch and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes on as his replacement.

64' CLOSE! Suat Serdar (Verona) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
63' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
62' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Grigoris Kastanos and he is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
62' Substitution. Casper Tengstedt is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
62' Ondrej Duda (Verona) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
61' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
61' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. AS Roma earn a corner.
59' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
57' Angelino (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
56' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and it's Casper Tengstedt (Verona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
54' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Matteo Marcenaro to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved AS Roma players can finally celebrate.
54' Wait! Referee Matteo Marcenaro has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' 2 - 2 Goal! Zeki Celik puts the ball on a plate for Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:2.
51' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
49' Mile Svilar displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Casper Tengstedt (Verona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
47' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Tomas Suslov (Verona) for his blatant foul.
46' The ball is cleared after Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will take a throw-in.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Angelino (AS Roma) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

41' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
39' Manu Kone (AS Roma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
38' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
35' Mile Svilar (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

34' 2 - 1 Goal! Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from Ondrej Duda. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 2:1.
34' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

33' That was close by Casper Tengstedt (Verona)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
32' The rebound finds Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicola Zalewski tees up Matias Soule (AS Roma) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
25' Unbelievable miss! Matias Soule (AS Roma) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
24' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
19' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
13' 1 - 0 Casper Tengstedt (Verona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Mile Svilar with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
12' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
11' Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
6' Matias Soule (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Darko Lazovic (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Verona.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
